sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Sensation of a band just above ears. Bilious
headache.

sections.label: Stomach
Urine
sections.text:
Stitching, crampy pains; thick mucus, and
bright-red, mealy sediment.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Pimply, dry, rough, scaly. Eruption on scalp
extending to face and neck. Tumor of breast, with
pain. Psoriasis. Acne. Dry Eczema.
